welcome.title: Welcome to Storyteller
welcome.description: Your creative writing companion. Craft, organize, and bring your stories to life with AI-powered assistance.

stories.title: Create & Manage Stories
stories.description: Start new stories, organize your projects, and manage multiple works in progress. Each story is your canvas.

entities.title: Build Your Story World
entities.description: Add characters, blurbs, scenes, and chapters to structure your narrative. Organize your ideas and plot seamlessly.

ai.title: AI-Powered Generation
ai.description: Generate story content with AI assistance. Transform your ideas into compelling narratives with intelligent suggestions.

export.title: Export & Sync
export.description: Export your stories as PDFs, sync across devices, and never lose your work. Your stories are always with you.
